title: ArcCivs 0.1.46: aligned V3 mine, post-exhaustion work and worker surplus logistics
assumptions: Before/after baseline is published 0.1.45 SHA3ad9a12a505b49d17cea0e1c65a55a9013a6cb2c. These are source/design sensitivities before changing generator outputs, not measured production or enforced player/network caps.

One exhausted mine with one suitably equipped miner per participating owner. Low/base/high participants1/10/16; active mining hours per owner-day0.25/1/4. Night, travel, food, tool replacement, journal latency, full bags, viewer/chunk absence and blocked worksites reduce actual output. No offline catch-up.

Finished V2 mine before change produces0 items/hour. Proposed finished V3 generator has one item per6active seconds: ideal600events/hour, versus unchanged real excavation duration2seconds and ideal1800actions/hour. Finite native mine yields depend on world blocks and native getDrops(tool), not a synthetic ore table.

Exclusive generator probabilities95percentCOBBLESTONE/4percentCOAL/1percentRAW_IRON total100percent. Suitable-pickaxe assumption gives theoretical570/24/6items per activehour. Incompatible ore rolls become cobblestone; total output never exceeds1/action. These item units must not be added to currency totals.

Three/four/five aligned floors instead of one/two/three for building levels1/2/3. Gallery height3air with one cobblestone floor, 9x9ring around3x3shaft, four three-wide16-block branches. Finite expanded terrain/support counts will be recorded from exact final planner before release; no fixed payout is attached to geometric volume.

One normal native tool-use wear check per generator action and ordinary tool breakage, food, bag capacity and supplies remain. No Fortune or Silk extra synthetic output. Paid V2 receipts recover under historical V2 geometry; migration scans real blocks and grants no reward for already-air cells or merely advancing cursor.

Worker surplus export transfers existing plain items from producer bag to courier bag and warehouse. It mints no extra item and must preserve total quantity/replay exactly once. Equipped tools, food, active inputs and reserve stay. Seed reserve is one authored field reseed; quarry reserve16ladders/8torches/32cobble. Metadata items stay intact.

Direct Vault,tokens,playerXP delta0 separately. Current SELL and planned SELL-off/contract transition remain unchanged; sale prices and realizable conversion of generated resources have not been established, so no guessed redemption mint is entered. Any later sale is one external conversion, not another generator reward.

Supported ledger168hour read from classic/spawn reported19participants,3121operations; Vault net66064514.69 dominated by admin_command mint67001499, so not a normal-earnings baseline. Vault145unclassifiedoperations and tokens5unclassifiedoperations remain. Shop sales subset complete:106.14attributed income,3transactions,107items. Zero sampled autosell chests does not establish autosell OFF.

Stress alternative:3miners per owner would triple the item sensitivities below; this is a multiplier scenario, not a proven slot limit. Throughput of retained finite mining can increase when export prevents a full bag; the unchanged1800actions/hour ceiling and real terrain volume bound it.
